title: Board Pointer Blocker Deep Trace
description: Board/canvas still non-interactive after OriginDocumentListener bubble + ContextMenuController bubble. Find any remaining capture listeners, overlays, or focus traps.
summary: Board remained dead under hosts that register document capture listeners before the canvas bubble chain. Added optional window capture bridge for pointerdown/move/up/wheel (guarded off under Vitest via process.env.VITEST and import.meta.env.VITEST). Left contextmenu on the event surface only so Playwright synthetic contextmenu and real right-clicks still open menus. Repaired accidental duplicate method corruption during edit.
